title: Ray Lago
description: "l dunno, but if the Master who trained Obi-Wan Kenobi told me, 'Your weapons, you will not need them' I'd like to think I'd leave 'em behind," says Ray Lago. "It makes ya wonder what Luke would have found in the cave if he'd entered unarmed." Lago was an award-winning commercial illustrator and a video paintbox artist for three major networks when he abandoned lucrative employment for comics, starting with Marvel's OPEN SPACE series. Other credits include IVANHOE for First Publishing/Classics Illustrated, Marvel/Epic's HELLRAISER, and covers for various Dark Horse titles including the PREDATOR: COLD WAR trade paperback and the ROBOCOP: MORTAL COILS mini-series.
